status: Prepared, not compiled or executed. No weights staged.

claims.int4_support: Installed MPPTensorOpsMatMul2d.h lines52–61 lists half/bfloat by int4/uint4 with float destination. MTLTensor.h exposes Int4/UInt4 from macOS26.4.
claims.integer_execution: Implementation selects distinct externally defined half/uint4 entry points. Public headers do not reveal ISA or promise faster integer hardware rather than conversion. Speed is unmeasured.
claims.bf16: Supported, but same16-bit storage and lower mantissa precision than the current half data; no documented speed advantage over half in the inspected sources.
claims.cooperative_inputs: Installed implementation requires one SIMD group, static K, and non-transposed cooperative inputs. This prototype uses four-SIMD ops with a threadgroup half tile instead.
claims.new_planes: WWDC26 describes new macOS27 block-scaled tensor planes; the installed26.5 tensor descriptor has no auxiliaryPlanes field. No dependency on an SDK upgrade is introduced.
